Psychiatrist
Royal Mental Health Hospital
177 Park Avenue Newtown

29/11/2014

Dear Dr McLennan,
Re: Ms Dolores Hoffmann, DOB 22/06/1986

I am writing to refer Ms Hoffmann, who has been recently diagnosed with reactive depression and
anxiety, for further assessment and management.

Ms Hoffmann is single with no family in Australia. She works as a sales assistant with a lot of stress and
work commitment.                                                                                             Comment [MG2]: commitments

On 22/11/2014, Ms Hoffmann reported an increased work stress that caused her depression,
nightmares and insomnia. [The work stress also caused her difficulty getting up, anorexia, a low libido].    Comment [MG3]: contributed to
She had a poor memory and poor concentration. Additionally, she had loss of pleasure, loss of
                                                                                                             Comment [MG4]: and
confidence and a low tolerance for alcohol.

Please note that Ms Hoffmann has recently broken up with her boyfriend and now lives alone. She is
considering quitting her job. Although I recommended her to be referred to a psychiatrist, she refused
the idea. Accordingly, temazepam 20 mg was prescribed to control her condition.

On today's review, [Ms Hoffmann did not take her temazepam]. However, she accepted the referral to           Comment [MG5]: has not taken
you.

In light of the above, I would be grateful if you could take over the ongoing care of Ms Hoffmann.
Please keep me updated on her condition as she is a regular patient at my clinic. Should there be any
queries, please do not hesitate to contact me.

Yours sincerely,
Doctor
